batch.reflection_textures: All owned full256-by-256 tile IDs in original frame order

pose.reflection_phase: Live actor DWORD+0x3C, supported0..65535; nonreflective unused out-of-range data emits0
pose.reflection_scroll: Live original float32 actor+0x30/+0x38, x87 nearest/ties-even then lowbyte divided256; original integer-indefinite maps to0

normals.source: Original counted float3 normal table from part+0x20; same basis as exported vertex positions

shader.view_position: Original unshifted camera inverse basis*(worldPosition-originalCameraOrigin). Existing shifted eye path:properCamera*(worldPosition-eye)+(0,0,128). Do not apply Metal X flip.
shader.normal: Original authored normal transformed by original part-to-view rotation; do not normalize
shader.uv_wrap: Keep signed/unwrapped UV per vertex; repeat only while sampling per fragment

limits: Frontend deliberately preserves the existing interpolated Euler/part pose matrices; original Q14 matrix quantization differs slightly. Do not claim pixel-identical reflections.
C0/E0 palette-effect shadows and smoke remain outside this focused glass restoration.
